zones.name: Abandoned Site
zones.desc: A base built with the remnants of the old ruins, located at the entrance to Uruthumheim from Moslan Forest.

zones.name: Battlescar Mound
zones.desc: A hill in Altgard where a massive clash between Balaur and defiant Daeva took place. Now it is a peaceful meadow frequented by grazing animals.

zones.name: Battlescar Mound
zones.desc: A hill in Altgard where a massive clash between Balaur and defiant Daeva took place. Now it is a peaceful meadow frequented by grazing animals.

zones.name: Briskwind Shelter
zones.desc: A hidden base at the canyon where refugees from all over Altgard gather. The food supply is poor, so empty bellies abound.

zones.name: Calderon Canyon
zones.desc: A canyon in northern Altgard. There are various minerals and caves located along the north of the canyon.

zones.name: Corrupted Forester Ruins
zones.desc: A former hideout and home to the Nornir who protected the forest, until their souls were stolen during an attack by the Blades. Now in ruins, the hideout is filled with the vengeful wraiths driven mad by despair.

zones.name: Creion Campsite
zones.desc: A temporary camp set up by Creion for researching the Dredgion.

zones.name: Dranactus
zones.desc: Land used by the Balaur to raise Drana for their food supply. Drana has stained the entire area red, with Balaur and their minions wherever one looks.

zones.name: Dranactus
zones.desc: Land used by the Balaur to raise Drana for their food supply. Drana has stained the entire area red, with Balaur and their minions wherever one looks.

zones.name: Dredgion Crash Site
zones.desc: An area where the Dredgion of the Fafnir Brigade crashed after being caught in the Abyss Rift accident. The surrounding soil is heavily contaminated with waste fluids from the ship.

zones.name: Dredgion Crash Site
zones.desc: An area where the Dredgion of the Fafnir Brigade crashed after being caught in the Abyss Rift accident. The surrounding soil is heavily contaminated with waste fluids from the ship.

zones.name: Eastern Gribade Highland
zones.desc: The upper eastern area of Gribade Highland—no more than a parched land with only a small patch of grass. A temporary campsite has been built by a Black Claw search party sent to capture Amunta and members of the Daybreak Society.

zones.name: Eastern Gribade Highland
zones.desc: The upper eastern area of Gribade Highland—no more than a parched land with only a small patch of grass. A temporary campsite has been built by a Black Claw search party sent to capture Amunta and members of the Daybreak Society.

zones.name: Eastern Gribade Highland
zones.desc: The upper eastern area of Gribade Highland—no more than a parched land with only a small patch of grass. A temporary campsite has been built by a Black Claw search party sent to capture Amunta and members of the Daybreak Society.

zones.name: Eastern Gribade Highland
zones.desc: The upper eastern area of Gribade Highland—no more than a parched land with only a small patch of grass. A temporary campsite has been built by a Black Claw search party sent to capture Amunta and members of the Daybreak Society.

zones.name: Faded Stump
zones.desc: A base for the Spirit Guides and Nornir that came to investigate the Sacred Tree Grisilla in relation to the strange happenings in the Purifying Forest.

zones.name: Fang Hideout
zones.desc: A building that once housed Zikel's Faithful before they entered the sanctum, until a Balaur bombardment destroyed all but the basement. It now serves as a hideout for the Fang Legion as they fight against the Balaur.

zones.name: Forest Marauder Campsite
zones.desc: A marauder hideout hidden within the Purifying Forest. This group particularly despises the Karas and loots all forest inhabitants, Nornirs and Karas alike.

zones.name: Galorik's Inspection Area
zones.desc: A Safe Haven Inspection Area managed by the village militia. It is used to defend against the invasion of the Legion Outlaws and to prevent unauthorized people from entering the village.

zones.name: Gravekeeper Camp
zones.desc: A base occupied mainly by gravekeepers.

zones.name: Graverobber Den
zones.desc: A den of grave robber Daeva obsessed with an relic buried in a tomb. They've set up camp near the cemetery and are causing havoc. They are notorious even among fellow grave robbers.

zones.name: Guide Rest Stop
zones.desc: A base for the Spirit Guides who are investigating the strange phenomena happening in the Purifying Forest.

zones.name: Hidden Cave
zones.desc: A cave on the side of a dumpsite for organic waste derived from Drana cultivation. It is also used as a hideout by the Salvation Legion before they escape after rescuing their imprisoned comrades.

zones.name: Mahindel River
zones.desc: A large river that bisects the eastern region of Altgard from north to south. After the fall of AION, the river basin expanded because of changes to the landscape.

zones.name: Minushan Site
zones.desc: This is where the stone statues of Uruthum and the eleven Daevas who defeated Minusha were erected. Currently, the site is in ruins as several statues are missing and the structure has deteriorated over time.

zones.name: Moslan Forest
zones.desc: A forested area between Altgard Fortress and the Vaspelt Timberlands. Under the care of the Elim, it was once home to a variety of flora and fauna, but recent raids by the Blood Blades have left it in ruins.

zones.name: Moslan Forest
zones.desc: A forested area between Altgard Fortress and the Vaspelt Timberlands. Under the care of the Elim, it was once home to a variety of flora and fauna, but recent raids by the Blood Blades have left it in ruins.

zones.name: Moslan Forest
zones.desc: A forested area between Altgard Fortress and the Vaspelt Timberlands. Under the care of the Elim, it was once home to a variety of flora and fauna, but recent raids by the Blood Blades have left it in ruins.

zones.name: Moslan Forest
zones.desc: A forested area between Altgard Fortress and the Vaspelt Timberlands. Under the care of the Elim, it was once home to a variety of flora and fauna, but recent raids by the Blood Blades have left it in ruins.

zones.name: Munin's Bridge
zones.desc: A bridge that connects northern Altgard to the Moslan Forest. Named by the Nornir after their teacher Munin.

zones.name: Nameless Cemetery
zones.desc: A graveyard for those who died fighting the Balaur. The sheer amount of dead has meant that many were buried without headstones, and the spirits of those Daeva who failed to return to the flow of Odyle roam freely.

zones.name: Nameless Cemetery
zones.desc: A graveyard for those who died fighting the Balaur. The sheer amount of dead has meant that many were buried without headstones, and the spirits of those Daeva who failed to return to the flow of Odyle roam freely.

zones.name: Nameless Cemetery
zones.desc: A graveyard for those who died fighting the Balaur. The sheer amount of dead has meant that many were buried without headstones, and the spirits of those Daeva who failed to return to the flow of Odyle roam freely.

zones.name: Neglected Crematorium
zones.desc: A former crematorium, but abandoned since the Karas Massacre. It is now occasionally used by gravekeepers to store supplies.

zones.name: Nornir Assembly
zones.desc: A new base for the Nornir, who have gathered here from all over Moslan Forest while fleeing the attacks of the Blood Blades. The residence of Urd, who leads the Nornir, is here.

zones.name: Nornir Assembly
zones.desc: A new base for the Nornir, who have gathered here from all over Moslan Forest while fleeing the attacks of the Blood Blades. The residence of Urd, who leads the Nornir, is here.

zones.name: North Laborer's Tent
zones.desc: A tent situated in the north, housing human laborers working in Dranactus. Its fabric is so worn that it hardly suits to keep out the rain. Drugged and delirious laborers either rest in a daze, or collapse while struggling to catch their breath.

zones.name: Purifying Forest
zones.desc: A forest protected by the power of the ancient Sacred Tree Grisilla. Because of the contamination resulting from Fafnir's Poison Blood, Grisilla has weakened and the entire forest is losing its purifying powers.

zones.name: Purifying Forest
zones.desc: A forest protected by the power of the ancient Sacred Tree Grisilla. Because of the contamination resulting from Fafnir's Poison Blood, Grisilla has weakened and the entire forest is losing its purifying powers.

zones.name: Quai Campsite
zones.desc: A base of the Quai Merchant Guild, who once dominated Altgard's commerce until they were ousted by the Steel Hammer Merchants and forced to move to their current location. Baba, the head of this branch, is looking for a way to regain the Guild's footing by helping Nemon.

zones.name: Rubek Thieves' Occupied Territory
zones.desc: The main base of a bandit group occupying Calderon Canyon. They expanded their power using illegal explosives and now pillage anyone in sight, human or Shugo alike.

zones.name: Safe Haven
zones.desc:
A village in northern Altgard with a long history.
Having developed over time as a refuge for those fleeing legal troubles or the Balaur, its residents are extremely wary of outsiders.
More recently, a Balaur Dredgion crashed in front of the village, isolating it further from the outside world, but also making it generally safe from Balaur threats.

zones.name: Safe Haven
zones.desc:
A village in northern Altgard with a long history.
Having developed over time as a refuge for those fleeing legal troubles or the Balaur, its residents are extremely wary of outsiders.
More recently, a Balaur Dredgion crashed in front of the village, isolating it further from the outside world, but also making it generally safe from Balaur threats.

zones.name: Sanctum Outpost
zones.desc: Once the main base of the Destruction Archons operating near Zikel's Sanctum, it has since been taken over by the Balaur. Now that the Daeva's rebellion has been quelled, Draconute troops manage the area.

zones.name: Sanctum Outpost
zones.desc: Once the main base of the Destruction Archons operating near Zikel's Sanctum, it has since been taken over by the Balaur. Now that the Daeva's rebellion has been quelled, Draconute troops manage the area.

zones.name: Sanctum Outpost
zones.desc: Once the main base of the Destruction Archons operating near Zikel's Sanctum, it has since been taken over by the Balaur. Now that the Daeva's rebellion has been quelled, Draconute troops manage the area.

zones.name: Sanctum Outpost
zones.desc: Once the main base of the Destruction Archons operating near Zikel's Sanctum, it has since been taken over by the Balaur. Now that the Daeva's rebellion has been quelled, Draconute troops manage the area.

zones.name: Sanctum Outpost
zones.desc: Once the main base of the Destruction Archons operating near Zikel's Sanctum, it has since been taken over by the Balaur. Now that the Daeva's rebellion has been quelled, Draconute troops manage the area.

zones.name: Sanctum Outskirts Watch
zones.desc: An outpost established by the Balaur outside the Sanctum Outpost. Though disguised as a simple outpost, it is actually a facility for testing Draconute modification, with many violent Draconutes who have slipped beyond Drakan control.

zones.name: Searcher Rock
zones.desc: A base located near the Dredgion ship that crashed in the Calderon Canyon. Access to Dredgion is impossible due to the Drakana oozing out of the ship.

zones.name: Silent Hill
zones.desc: A hilly area between the Nameless Cemetery and the Sanctum Outpost.

zones.name: Silent Hill
zones.desc: A hilly area between the Nameless Cemetery and the Sanctum Outpost.

zones.name: Southern Gribade Highland
zones.desc: The highlands located between the Western and Eastern Gribade Highlands, to the south of Idun's Lake. The road to Zemurru's Tomb is located here, but it is not being maintained.

zones.name: South Laborer's Tent
zones.desc: A tent situated in the south, housing human laborers working in Dranactus. Its fabric is so worn that it hardly suits to keep out the rain. Drugged and delirious laborers either rest in a daze, or collapse while struggling to catch their breath.

zones.name: Temporary Investigation Base
zones.desc: A temporary base built to investigate the area around the Dredgion Crash Site. Dispatched Daeva are keeping an eye on this area and are carrying out the tasks given by Nemon.

zones.name: Tranein Highland
zones.desc: A peaceful hill on the outskirts of the Sanctum Outpost.

zones.name: Tranein Pond
zones.desc: A small pond on the Tranein Highland.

zones.name: Uruthumheim
zones.desc: Built to honor a Daeva named Uruthum who led eleven warriors to slay the giant Drake Minusha during the Millennium War, this site has since crumbled to ruins.

zones.name: Victorious Daeva's Statue
zones.desc: This is where the stone statue of Uruthum was erected to share the news of triumph after defeating the great Drake Minusha.

zones.name: Basfelt Ruins
zones.desc: This place was once a village of loggers and hunters until it was largely destroyed by the Balaur. Now it is overgrown bush, and the terrain where the Balaur bombardment was concentrated is pitted and twisted, leaving only the shattered ruins of Zikel's Temple.

zones.name: Basfelt Ruins
zones.desc: This place was once a village of loggers and hunters until it was largely destroyed by the Balaur. Now it is overgrown bush, and the terrain where the Balaur bombardment was concentrated is pitted and twisted, leaving only the shattered ruins of Zikel's Temple.

zones.name: Flauke Legion Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost now held by the Flauke Legion. Once protectors of the Purifying Forest, they became deeply demoralized after suffering a brutal defeat to the Balaur. Driven by the power of Fafnite, Commander Flauke is now guilty of innumerous atrocities.

zones.name: Basfelt Ruins
zones.desc: This place was once a village of loggers and hunters until it was largely destroyed by the Balaur. Now it is overgrown bush, and the terrain where the Balaur bombardment was concentrated is pitted and twisted, leaving only the shattered ruins of Zikel's Temple.

zones.name: Legion Base Ruins
zones.desc: A site where a small legion resisting the Balaur was annihilated. Daeva soldiers whose bodies and souls have been split now wander aimlessly. The Balaur intend to seal these specters within the ruins and repurpose them into an immortal brigade.

zones.name: Mahindel Cliff
zones.desc: A small stretch of land connecting northern and southern Altgard. Once a crucial trading hub for Shulak merchants, it now serves as little more than a bridge.

zones.name: Fafnite Deposit
zones.desc: A Fafnite Gemstone Mine located in the Gribade Highland. The Steel Hammer Merchants, who obtained the mining rights from the Balaur, are using their laborers to dig for Fafnite Gemstones.

zones.name: Western Gribade Highland
zones.desc: A rugged territory south of the Mahindel River, which splits Altgard into north and south. Outlaws are currently occupying the area and are extending the reach of their power.

zones.name: Western Gribade Highland
zones.desc: A rugged territory south of the Mahindel River, which splits Altgard into north and south. Outlaws are currently occupying the area and are extending the reach of their power.

zones.name: Amunta's Hideout
zones.desc: The hideout of Ritualist Amunta who was exiled from Black Claw Village. In the past, there were many crates of supplies for the Daybreak Society, but now they have been looted and are empty.

zones.name: Barahta Extermination Unit Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost garrisoned by Balaur of the Lagta Brigade. Responsible for hunting down any local resistance, they are notorious for being among the most brutal of the Balaur.

zones.name: Idun's Lake
zones.desc: A bitterly cold lake, surrounded by thick mist. Its black waters are heavily polluted by runoff from the Gribade mines, making it difficult even to approach and earning it the moniker "the Lake of the Dead".

zones.name: Black Claw Village
zones.desc: The village of the Black Claw Tribe, Mau minions of the Balaur. As soon as the Black Claw Tribe experienced the power of Fafnite, they disavowed their ancestors and swore allegiance to the Balaur in pursuit of ever-greater power.

zones.name: Black Claw Village
zones.desc: The village of the Black Claw Tribe, Mau minions of the Balaur. As soon as the Black Claw Tribe experienced the power of Fafnite, they disavowed their ancestors and swore allegiance to the Balaur in pursuit of ever-greater power.

zones.name: Black Claw Village
zones.desc: The village of the Black Claw Tribe, Mau minions of the Balaur. As soon as the Black Claw Tribe experienced the power of Fafnite, they disavowed their ancestors and swore allegiance to the Balaur in pursuit of ever-greater power.

zones.name: Kumrica's Cellar
zones.desc: A cellar beneath the tree housing Kumrica, a member of the Daybreak Society. Inside are food, weapons, and other supplies needed for survival in an emergency.

zones.name: Lagta Fortress
zones.desc: The main base of the Lagta Brigade, who rule over Altgard under High Commander Lagta. The base periodically sends Fafnite to Ishalgen and Morheim.

zones.name: Impetusium Square
zones.desc: A large square in front of the Impetusium. Its structures have been destroyed, with only a few traces of stairs and columns remaining, and it is now occupied by Balaur working hard to find a way to penetrate the Blood Barrier. Balaur camps and sabotage devices are dotted all over.

zones.name: Impetusium Square
zones.desc: A large square in front of the Impetusium. Its structures have been destroyed, with only a few traces of stairs and columns remaining, and it is now occupied by Balaur working hard to find a way to penetrate the Blood Barrier. Balaur camps and sabotage devices are dotted all over.

zones.name: Immortal Isle
zones.desc: An island isolated far from the rest of Altgard, now made accessible by a recently discovered Windstream. Because it was isolated from Altgard long ago, the island's ecosystem evolved separately.

zones.name: Abandoned Campsite
zones.desc: A campsite used by the Shulak, until they abandoned it as the Blades increased their presence in the area. It is now home to surviving members of legions destroyed by the Blades.

zones.name: Amurahta Surveillance Base
zones.desc: A Balaur base set up to monitor the area around Black Claw Village. Watch Captain Amurahta keeps a close eye to ensure the local Mau do their work efficiently, and extorts them for their supplies under the pretext of offering them protection.

zones.name: Andsha Forward Base
zones.desc: An outpost manned by Balaur of the Lagta Brigade, built to support their research into destroying the Blood Barrier. Whether human or Shulak, any who dare approach Impetusium Square without permission are attacked indiscriminately.

zones.name: Basfelt Waterfall
zones.desc: A small base naturally formed around a waterfall as more and more people move in and out of the area. Refugees, grave robbers and relic seekers travelling to and from the Basfelt Ruins.

zones.name: Blades Temporary Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost established by Blades in Moslan Forest to facilitate hunting down any surviving Nornir. Rumor has it that somewhere within the outpost lies a treasure chest filled with valuables looted from the Nornir.

zones.name: Collapsed Chasm
zones.desc: A small clearing between the stones and fallen trees. The young Elim used to come here and play, but the Blood Blades set it ablaze and destroyed it.

zones.name: Collapsed Hall Of Fame
zones.desc: A small hall at the bottom of Impetusium Hill. It once housed a statue of Daeva, the winners of the Impetusium, but now it has been destroyed and only traces remain.

zones.name: Destroyed Ruins
zones.desc: The remains of a temple attached to the Destruction Archon Fortress. The building is completely destroyed, and only a few broken stone statues remain. In the center, there is a half-broken stele inscribed with the Archon Oath.

zones.name: Detlef Thieves Camp
zones.desc: A group of thieves based in Western Gribade Highland. Originally, they preyed on nearby refugees, but now they cooperate with the Blades, handing over to them any suspicious outsiders passing through.

zones.name: Elim's Rest
zones.desc: Originally a rest stop for visitors to the forest, the Elim came to stay here when visitors came less frequently. There are no Elim left after the Blades set fire to it.

zones.name: Fissure Cave
zones.desc: A natural cave between the cliffs of Basfelt Ruins. Graverobbers, fleeing from the Blades, hide here.

zones.name: Forest Hideout
zones.desc: A small cave on the outskirts of Moslan Forest. It was used as a refuge by local residents when the forest was burning.

zones.name: Granach's Hideout
zones.desc: A hideout of wanted criminals who originally worked for the Steel Hammer Merchants until they were caught smuggling goods. Now settled in the Eastern Gribade Highland, they continue to target passing merchants.

zones.name: Graverobber Campsite
zones.desc: A small base for a group of people who make their living searching for and stealing relics from the Basfelt Ruins. It consists of a barely more than a few mud huts and stacked chests of looted goods.

zones.name: Healing Spring
zones.desc: A spring imbued with restorative powers that can clear an area of any toxic aura. Since the Purifying Forest has been losing its power, the spring's power has also been weakening.

zones.name: Latrima Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost of elite Balaur forces monitoring and patrolling Dranactus. They oversee Drana cultivation while keeping watch over the area. A teleportation device allows them to rapidly reinforce their forces, making this a key base.

zones.name: Logger's Rest Ruins
zones.desc: A small rest stop that was originally home to the loggers of Moslan Forest before being taken over by a band of thieves after the forest burned down. The thieves hunt forest creatures or rob refugees who pass through.

zones.name: Mire Campsite
zones.desc: A place where criminals exiled even from Safe Haven eke out a living by digging through the debris of the crashed Dredgion for useful items, or fishing relics out of the streams of wastewater.

zones.name: Moslan Forest
zones.desc: A forested area between Altgard Fortress and the Vaspelt Timberlands. Under the care of the Elim, it was once home to a variety of flora and fauna, but recent raids by the Blood Blades have left it in ruins.

zones.name: Muqaka's Quarters
zones.desc: Quarters where Muqaka, the Chief of Black Claw Village, resides. All Fafnite production and trade statements, among other important documents, are kept in his quarters.

zones.name: Odar's Shade
zones.desc: An Elim village at the entrance to Moslan Forest founded under the leadership of Odar, an Elim elder. A recent attack by the Blood Blades resulted in the Elim Odar falling into a deep sleep, and the Nornir in the village being abducted.

zones.name: Outskirts Stall
zones.desc: A street stall of Shulak located on the road to Morheim. It sells goods from Morheim or medicines that can only be found in the southernmost part of Altgard.

zones.name: Root of the Sacred Tree Entrance
Secret Rendezvous Point
zones.desc: A secret rendezvous point for the Daybreak Society. Once used to store totems, it has long sat abandoned. Broken totems lie scattered, coated in dust.

zones.name: Shulak Street Stall
zones.desc: A street stall set up by Shulak trading in the looted goods from the Basfelt Ruins. Despite its small size, it is popular for its wide range of products and willingness to obtain rare items for an extra price.

zones.name: Steel Hammer Base
zones.desc: A rest area for Shulak who guard the Gates of Fafnir.

zones.name: Steel Hammer Merchants HQ
zones.desc:
A town established by Shulak of the Steel Hammer Merchants.
It was originally a base for the Quai Merchant Guild, and a port that boasted a status as the logistical center of Altgard, with a steady stream of airships carrying goods from the Abyss and across Asmodae. It has since been taken over by the Steel Hammer Merchants, collaborators with the Balaur.

zones.name: Steel Hammer Temporary Trading Post
zones.desc: A temporary trading post for the Steel Hammer Merchants, located south of Idun's Lake. Established to facilitate trade between Amunta and Popokiki, it enjoys a prime location on the route connecting Southern and Eastern Gribade, but is modest in terms of scale.

zones.name: Steel Hammer Workcamp
zones.desc: A camp for Shulak laborers. It is also used to mine and load the surrounding Fafnite gemstones. The mined gemstones and carts are scattered around.

zones.name: Temporary Retreat
zones.desc: A place where the Fang Legion, who had infiltrated the Sanctum Outpost, hides from the Balaur's eyes.

zones.name: Watcher's Tent
zones.desc: A small campsite built in the northern Tranein Highland. Avent, Nemon's loyal subordinate, resides here to watch over the Tranein Lake area.

zones.name: Zemurru's Tomb
zones.desc: A base for members of the Daybreak Society fleeing Black Claw Village. It was once a sacred place to the Mau because of the grave of their great hero, Zemurru, but no one visits anymore.
